subject: Re: Saturday lane problem
text:
I read the complaint about the blocked lane, and I agree it cannot stay unresolved.

You are right that Saturday morning became crowded. I arrived around eight and saw the same problem you described: the bike trailers, the broken patio chair, and the spare cooler occupying space nobody had claimed. That created a backup near the fire lane.

I checked the schedule. The community shed still has two empty bays through next month, and both are near the back gate. They would take at least the two large items causing the issue. Each bay costs fifteen dollars per month and requires a refundable key deposit. If each household can claim one bay before noon on Wednesday, I can forward the list to maintenance.

If the shed is rejected, the only other option is limiting Saturday access to the east row only. That will keep the west lane open, but it means fewer cars.

I am not trying to rehash the earlier emails. I only need one decision. Reply with a yes or no by Tuesday evening. After that, I will assume the shed plan is preferred and pass it along.
